arguments.code:
token = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=token)['access_token']

# fetch all playlists in library (paged)
playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'count', 0 if not page else len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(playlists))
playlist_ids = [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists]
print('playlist_ids', playlist_ids)

# compute total duration per playlist
results = []
for p in playlists:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=token)
    durations_sec = [s.get('duration', 0) for s in pl.get('songs', [])]
    total_sec = sum(durations_sec)
    total_min = total_sec / 60
    results.append({
        'playlist_id': p['playlist_id'],
        'title': p['title'],
        'num_songs': len(durations_sec),
        'total_min': total_min,
        'total_sec': total_sec
    })

# show totals
for r in sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['total_min'], reverse=True):
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['num_songs'], 'min', r['total_min'])

max_r = max(results, key=lambda x: x['total_min'])
print('max_playlist', max_r)
rounded = int(round(max_r['total_min']))
print('rounded', rounded)
